say:1:1460706001:1.text: With friends' help, maybe we can breathe a little easier now!
say:1:1460706001:1.source_cn: 叫来其他同伴帮忙了，看来暂时不用担心神光之石的事了！

say:2:1460706002:1.text: Still, the land feels so empty after all these years. It's been too long since your last visit.
say:2:1460706002:1.source_cn: 不过，感觉这周围还是荒废得有些严重呢，毕竟您也很久没有...
say:2:1460706002:1.male: Still, the land feels so empty after all these years. It's been too long since your last visit.
say:2:1460706002:1.female: Still, the land feels so empty after all these years. It's been too long since your last visit.

say:3:1460706003:1.text: Rebuilding a home will require a lot of materials. Let's head to a logging site and gather as many logs as we can.
say:3:1460706003:1.source_cn: 如果想要重建家园，会需要很多材料。我们去找找能够采伐许...
